Reason for Mistake: The Assistant miscalculated the volume by using an incorrect approximation for the density of Freon-12 at high pressure (1.5 g/cm³). The actual expected density at pressures such as 1100 atm and a temperature of 4°C would be substantially higher than this, as fluids compress significantly under such extreme conditions. This led to an incorrect estimation of the volume of Freon-12 refrigerant, producing an erroneous final answer (208 mL instead of the correct answer, 55 mL). The error was rooted in the reliance on standard data for moderate pressures and temperatures without accounting for the compression effects caused by the extreme conditions at the bottom of the Marianas Trench.
